## Overview

## Source-listed information

- **Manufacturer:** Mahindra
- **Model Version:** 3-door AXT/LXT brochure generation; excludes Thar ROXX/5-door
- **Powertrain:** D117 CRDe 1497cc diesel; mHawk 130 CRDe 2184cc diesel; mStallion 150 TGDi 1997cc petrol
- **Dimensions:** 3985mm length ×1820mm width; 2450mm wheelbase; brochure heights 1850/1855mm by trim
- **Seating Capacity:** 4
- **Ground Clearance:** 226 mm (brochure specification)
- **Water Wading Depth:** 650 mm (brochure specification)
- **Brakes:** 303mm front disc; 282mm rear drum
- **Suspension:** Independent double-wishbone front; multilink solid rear axle
- **Steering:** Hydraulic rack-and-pinion
- **Safety:** Dual front airbags; ABS/EBD/brake assist; ESP/roll-over mitigation; hill hold/descent; rear ISOFIX
- **Features:** AXT/LXT equipment differs; LXT lists 10.25-inch display, rear camera and tyre-pressure monitoring
- **Price Basis:** Named manufacturer variant examples; not a global starting price or on-road quote
